messages:
Renee: Final checklist for DevCon roadshow booth (SF next week). Need: 1) one-sheet press blurb for on-desk distro, 2) quick on-screen loop (15s) of benchmark claim, 3) swag reconciliation after vendor shorted two boxes, 4) webinar follow-up funnel. Who owns what?
Caleb: I'll handle swag reconciliation. Vendor shorted 2 boxes of tote bags. They offered a partial refund or expedited top-up. Recommend top-up. Budget approved?
Renee: Approve expedited top-up. Please get ETA and confirm final qty by EOD.
Caleb: ETA for top-up: next-day delivery Mon 10am. Final qty: 450 totes, 300 stickers, 75 polos. Invoice link: https://orders.vendor/INV-4512
Nora: I'll take the on-screen loop and the one-sheet copy. Draft one-sheet will be 2 paragraphs + 3 bullets. Legal flagged the explicit p95 numbers in the benchmark; I'll use "meets sub-100ms typical latency" phrasing until they clear.
Samir: I'll own the webinar funnel and lead routing. Plan: QR -> lightweight Typeform -> Segment -> HubSpot list "devcon_sf". Immediate email: webinar signup + recording promise; 5-day nurture: benchmark brief; 12-day SDR outreach.
Renee: Samir, paste Segment mapping and consent filter here so SalesOps can pre-map.
Samir: mapping: name -> traits.name, email -> traits.email, company -> traits.company, interest -> traits.interest, source -> traits.event = "devcon_sf". Filter: email present && marketing_consent == true. Will share the live Flow by 5pm.
ops-bot: Reminder: booth artwork must be uploaded 48hrs before printer cutoff. AV check slot booked for Tue 1:30pm. See https://ops.redwood/print-deadlines
Caleb: Packing list update: 2 rollups, demo laptop (local image), HDMI adapter, iPads (3) with stands, extra chargers, tote bags, polos. I'll bring barcode scanner as backup for paper leads.
Nora: One more: speaker update 1-min talk accepted for Day 2. Need slide deck + 1-line bio. I'll post draft slides for review by tomorrow.
Renee: Great. Quick sync 9am tomorrow to confirm swag top-up ETA and that Segment flow is shared. Post blockers here. :white_check_mark:
